## Not adopted

### `block-branch-for-epic-child.sh` — out of scope

*The-Claude-Protocol · `af754ef` · ruled in round-008-claude-protocol*

Same worktree/branch model presupposition, and internally contradictory at the pin: it forces children onto a shared bd-{EPIC_ID} branch while the worker template creates bd-{BEAD_ID} per child and validate-completion.sh checks the remote for the per-child branch that the shared model never creates. Also half-broken: primary detection reads a .conversation_context field the event does not supply.

### `block-orchestrator-tools.sh` — rejected

*The-Claude-Protocol · `af754ef` · ruled in round-008-claude-protocol*

Blanket write-denial for the session agent contradicts our Working Mode, which routes small tasks inline. On its own terms it is leaky: the git allowlist has no default-deny arm — push --force, reset --hard, clean -fd all fall through to exit 0 (:126-147, :167), all of which our block-dangerous-commands.sh denies — and the --no-verify test matches any '-n' substring (:138), denying innocent commits. The one good fragment, a bd create description floor (:154-161), is deferred: it would misfire on our thin idea-bead flow without an -l idea exemption, and we lack evidence thin beads cause rework.

### `enforce-branch-before-edit.sh` — out of scope

*The-Claude-Protocol · `af754ef` · ruled in round-008-claude-protocol*

Enforces edits-only-in-worktrees; presupposes worktree-per-task, which we do not run — our review packages the working tree because implementers do not commit.

### `inject-discipline-reminder.sh` — rejected

*The-Claude-Protocol · `af754ef` · ruled in round-008-claude-protocol*

Same broken mechanism as remind-inprogress (PreToolUse stdout never reaches the model); harmless upstream only because the payload is duplicated inside the injected worker contract. Nothing to borrow.

### `session-start.sh` — deferred

*The-Claude-Protocol · `af754ef` · ruled in round-008-claude-protocol*

The surfacing half of their knowledge loop is what our write-only learnings.md lacks, and SessionStart stdout genuinely reaches the model. Deferred into bead cr-iqu: last 3-5 learnings titles, a dirty-tree warning, and a stale-beads line added to bd-prime.sh, hard-capped. Rejected within it: worktree cleanup (no worktree model) and gh pr list (a network call every session).

### `validate-epic-close.sh` — deferred

*The-Claude-Protocol · `af754ef` · ruled in round-008-claude-protocol*

The shipped implementation is a no-op: it reads a CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT env var Claude Code never sets and exits 0 (:8, :11), and its own test drives it the same wrong way (tests/test-validate-epic-close.sh:37) — a suite validating the mock. But CHECK 2 (deny closing an epic with open children) is exactly the jq check our execution skill states as prose (execution/SKILL.md:89-93); deferred into bead cr-ghw as a stdin-driven reimplementation with a named override. CHECK 1 (merged-PR required) is rejected — it would deadlock our conservative commit/push authority.
